Twilio SendGrid email: send transactional and marketing mail through the v3 Mail Send API.

## API key

1. Sign in to [SendGrid](https://app.sendgrid.com) and open [Settings → API Keys](https://app.sendgrid.com/settings/api_keys).
2. Select **Create API Key**, choose **Restricted Access**, and give it **Mail Send** only.
3. Copy the key. It's shown once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add sendgrid
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  sendgrid: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls SendGrid's [API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show sendgrid` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** Each endpoint has its own limit; answers carry X-RateLimit-Limit, -Remaining and -Reset.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20SendGrid).
